content.title: Mountain silhouettes
content.summary: A set of mountain foothill silhouettes
content.body_markdown:
This is a multi-image gallery set for integration testing.

It has the layered silhouettes of many mountain ranges, the relaxed lines of a single mountain, and the mountain shadow cast in the golden light of sunset.

gallery_images.alt: Layered mountain ranges seen from afar in the park
gallery_images.caption: As your gaze lifts, it feels as if nature's veil is being lifted layer by layer.

gallery_images.alt: A large mountain in the distance
gallery_images.caption: Plate 02: Its flowing lines seem to let our spirits unfurl with them.

gallery_images.alt: The sunset beneath a lakeside pier
gallery_images.caption: Plate 03: The valley's embrace is enough to hold the sun.
